Sam (AE): Hey team — stuck on a special pricing path for AcmeHealth. CPQ is blocking 27% off with a 6mo commit on opp 0067-ACME. Need an expedited path, customer is ready to sign. @Jules (Deal Desk) @Marcus (Pricing) can you weigh in?
Jules (Deal Desk): On it. Can you paste the CPQ field snapshot and any legal flags? If there's a data residency or SOW ask we'll need the template.
Sam (AE): here's the CPQ snapshot:
```
opportunity_id: 0067-ACME
discount_requested: 27%
commit_months: 6
seat_count: 120
subscription_type: hosted
special_terms_flag: true
legal_notes: data residency request (EU-only)
```
Marcus (Pricing): 27% is outside the standard tier for that band (approved caps: 15%, 20%, 25%). Anything >25% requires VP Pricing exception. Need ARR and uplift justification + any reference deals.
Priya (SE): POC complete. They expect a 30% usage uplift in Q1 post-rollout. Performance numbers look good — I can attach the perf slides and token run rate.
Jules (Deal Desk): Two practical paths: reduce to 25% + 12mo commit, or pursue a pricing exception (expedite) for 27% with VP sign-off. Which does AE prefer?
Sam (AE): Customer will only do 6mo. They can sign today at 27% but legal must clear the EU residency clause.
Olivia (RevOps): I can start an expedite review. We honor a 24h SLA for expedite exceptions if sales sets SF field `expedite_approval=true` on the opp. Did you toggle that?
Sam (AE): Not yet — updating SF now.
DealBot: Opportunity 0067-ACME flagged `expedite_approval=true` by Sam (AE). Queuing priority review. :eyes:
Marcus (Pricing): I need an impact calc: ARR, expected monthly token consumption, and whether this will be hosted or dedicated. Send numbers here and I'll model margin impact.
Sam (AE): ARR = $280,000 ARR, hosted API, est 20M tokens/month. Customer doesn't need Dedicated. I'll DM the cost calc and attach usage table to the opp.
Jules (Deal Desk): OK — routing to VP Pricing for emergency sign-off. @Legal (Contract) please review the residency addendum `data_residency_addendum_v2`. If that is in the opp, we can fast-track. Expect response ~18 hrs if docs complete.
Legal (Contract): Please attach the requested addendum and confirm whether customer will sign the addendum at PO. If they do, we can proceed; otherwise this blocks shipment.
Sam (AE): Adding addendum and perf slides to the opp now: https://redwood.internal/docs/acme-perf - I'll ping when uploaded.
Jules (Deal Desk): Final admin: once signed, update SF fields `approved_by`, attach signed SOW, and set `deal_status=awaiting_signatures`. I'll mark the exception as approved in the deck and change the CPQ `approved_discount` field. :thumbsup:
Sam (AE): Thanks all — I'll do the uploads and follow up with the customer to get the addendum signed.
